messages:
pagerbot: AUTO-PAGE fired for inference-gateway-prod (eu-west1) — HTTP 5xx rate 18% over 5m (threshold 10%). Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Alert graph: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/333444 -- :rotating_light:
Sam K: @pagerbot acked. I'm the oncall. looking into ingress/proxy layer first.
Priya R: I'm watching logs + metrics. seeing a surge of HTTP/2 GOAWAY frames from ingress-proxy sidecars around the spike.
Darren L: Any recent deploys to ingress-proxy or envoy sidecars?
Sam K: Not in infra; there was a canary of model-router-service 5m before alerts. but that shouldn't affect TLS/upstream.
Maya S: Quick grep from the pod logs (snippet):
```
ingress-proxy 2026-03-15T01:26:32Z WARN http2.go:314 GOAWAY received: last_stream_id=0 err=INTERNAL_ERROR debug="stream reset"
ingress-proxy 2026-03-15T01:26:33Z ERROR handler.go:112 upstream write failed: write tcp 10.3.1.41:443->10.2.5.12:52344: connection reset by peer
```
Sam K: That looks like downstream (upstream from proxy) is sending GOAWAYs. Could be sidecar memory pressure or protocol negotiations failing.
Priya R: I'm seeing a pattern: spike in concurrent h2 streams then GOAWAY. CPU on ingress-proxy pods jumps to 95% at same time.
Darren L: Possible regression in our HTTP/2 keepalive or stream concurrency defaults. Also noticed increased keepalive timeouts in Envoy metrics.
oncall-rotation-bot: Reminder: @sam-k you have 25 minutes left on rotation.
Sam K: Understood, will handle initial mitigation and hand off if needed.
Sam K: Quick mitigation plan: 1) Reduce concurrency on gateway to limit inflight streams 2) Route traffic away from eu-west1 -> fallback to eu-west2 until stable 3) Rollback last proxy config (if any) or restart ingress-proxy to clear connections.
Priya R: Initiating traffic reroute: flipping route policy to prefer eu-west2 for the next 10 minutes.
eng-notify-bot: Update: RoutePolicy 'prefer-eu-west2' applied to inference-gateway-prod (weight 80%) by Priya R.
Sam K: Restarting ingress-proxy pods one by one to drain connections and get fresh envoys. command:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/ingress-proxy --timeout=5m
kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=ingress-proxy -o wide
```
Priya R: Also lowering max concurrent streams on proxy via runtime flag to 128 (was 512):
```
kubectl -n inference set env deployment/ingress-proxy MAX_H2_CONCURRENCY=128
```
Maya S: Running a quick canary after one pod restart — 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 9% on that node.
Sam K: Good sign. Continuing restarts and concurrency reduction.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: escalation to SRE secondary (Priya R) sent.
Darren L: Found one suspicious log in model-router-service canary: a flood of long-polling completion callbacks holding streams open for minutes. Could be increasing h2 stream count and triggering GOAWAY.
Priya R: We're seeing total active streams drop as we restart pods and lower concurrency. 5xx rate back to 3.2% cluster-wide.
Sam K: Rolling back the canary of model-router-service to confirmed stable revision (undo canary) to be safe:
```
kubectl -n platform rollout undo deployment/model-router-service --to-revision=12
```
Sam K: Confirming customer impact: error budget spike but only ~0.6% of total requests failed in the 15m window — most failures were streaming/reset clients. Not major but noticeable for integrations using persistent streams.
Maya S: Notified Support/CS: @support-team please check any EU customers on streaming endpoints for renewed tickets.
eng-notify-bot: Support channel notified by Maya S.
Priya R: Short-term mitigation succeeded: route fallback + restart + concurrency limit. We'll keep route favoring eu-west2 for 20 min while we monitor.
Sam K: Handing off to Darren for post-incident follow-up and postmortem. Darren, will you own RCA and runbook updates?
Darren L: I can. Preliminary RCA hypothesis: combined effect of a canary that increased long-lived streaming completions plus high default h2 concurrency in proxies caused connection churn and envoy GOAWAY storms under load. Will dig into traces and heap profiles.
Sam K: Thanks. Closing the active pager. Marking incident status: mitigated -> monitoring.
pagerbot: AUTO-PAGE resolved for inference-gateway-prod. Alert condition cleared.
Sam K: Final action items: Darren to file postmortem + remediation (limit canary traffic for streaming-heavy routes, add a circuit-breaker for long-lived streams), Priya to add a runtime gauge/alert for active h2 stream count, Maya to confirm customer outreach.
Darren L: Filed ticket INFR-5234 (postmortem + remediation) assigned to me.
Maya S: Handing off to night team — @oncall-rotation-bot please notify night rotation.
oncall-rotation-bot: Night rotation notified.
Sam K: Thanks all. I'll update the incident board and add the graphs + log snippets to the ticket. :thumbsup:
